judge.rationale: The core validation implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is well-written, closely matches the reference design (`ajv` compilation at registration, `WeakMap` caching, one-line doc comment, safe error formatting without leaking values), and would work properly. However, the candidate stopped mid-task, leaving an uncommitted `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad and omitting updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and a complete `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Additionally, most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (passthrough of extra properties, dynamic schema switching, unknown tool throw, compilation caching) and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were left unwritten or placed in a non-standard `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file.
